notes: The mining club (doc 51 v1.0 §4). Three invented friends; the club buys into the existing group buy (preorders.json group_buy) and runs Teo's two GPUs. Designed [D]; the backdrop cards are sourced.

cast.name: Mara Ilves

cast.name: Jun Okafor
cast.role: economics student; keeps the spreadsheet and, if asked, the keys

shares: by value put in (cash plus Teo's GPUs at used price)

buys.how: all pooled cash goes into the group buy at its price; its delay roll and the late-equals-loss rule apply

keys.player: club coins sit in your wallet: your wallet-loss and backup rules cover them

loss_chance_quarter.source: no failure-rate source found (doc 53 Part C); about 15% over the club life

gpus_coin: the club's GPUs follow the coin the player picks for them (BTC, LTC or DOGE)

endings.buy_out: pay each friend their share at 2016Q4 value; machines and coins become yours and enter Act I
endings.dissolve: machines sold at the used price, coins at the 2016Q4 price, everything split by shares
endings.chapter_report: Act I names the friends as the founding crew if bought out (text only)
